purpose: mechanism-level causal evaluation of Graphene evidence state, HypoKosh hypothesis selection/temporal change, and DWM challenge/reopen effectiveness

configurations.primary_role: persistent evidence/provenance capability; no hypothesis-selection claim

hypotheses.statement: G0 preserves and exposes evidence/provenance state deterministically across sequential observations.
G1 adds governed hypothesis selection relative to G0 without silently upgrading insufficient evidence to resolved.
After decisive new evidence, G1 changes the operative hypothesis when the oracle requires change and does not change it in negative controls.
G2 challenge/reopen activity produces useful search or corrected decisions beyond G1 on tasks requiring dialectical re-evaluation.
G2 does not introduce unnecessary churn on negative-control tasks.
G1/G2 explicitly abstain when evidence is insufficient for an earned selection under the preregistered task semantics.

measurement_rules.temporal_hypothesis_change: compare consecutive production decisions after each newly ingested observation
measurement_rules.native_revision_receipt: reported separately; never inferred from changed outputs
measurement_rules.reopen_effectiveness: a reopen is effective only if it changes bundle/frontier or changes the operative answer
measurement_rules.failures: reported by class and excluded from primary behavioural denominators; never imputed

repetitions.score_bearing: one untouched frozen campaign per configuration
